rule: candidates = models a (per-term logistic fusion), b (twin refiner), c (identity-gated twin) of src/cafa6/stacker_tv.py, for each L3 HiGO run with TV v2 predictions (runs/l3_c0_tv2, runs/l3_c1_tv2), each fit on TV v2 with 5-fold cross-fitting grouped by best-hit / TV-link / cluster components, test-like weights (chosen_v2 rule) as sample weights, each fold's step count chosen on the other four folds' held-out test-like Fmax curves (lofo), pooled out-of-fold predictions max-propagated and scored with knn_sharp.Scorer. A candidate is KEPT only if its cross-fitted TV v2 test-like mean Fmax minus that of the raw T5_k50_g0_na kNN prior is >= 0.005 AND the paired protein bootstrap 95% CI of that difference (1000 reps, test-like weights) excludes 0. Among kept candidates the highest cross-fitted test-like Fmax goes forward to a single test look; if none is kept, no stacker goes forward (the raw kNN prior stays). Smoke runs, val-split runs and HiGO-less runs are not selection runs.
verdict: no model kept: raw kNN stays
